content.value: Primary reading: Machine Learning Systems, Chapter 8. Supplemental: PyTorch Distributed Data Parallel tutorial and Horovod materials.

This unit studies training as a distributed systems problem. Students connect optimization mechanics to infrastructure: input pipelines, shuffling, prefetching, checkpointing, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, data parallelism, model parallelism, pipeline parallelism, synchronization, communication overhead, fault tolerance, and utilization. The unit emphasizes scaling efficiency: more hardware helps only when computation, communication, memory, and data loading are balanced.
Supplemental sources for this unit are listed in the references below. Use them to compare the textbook framing with public talks, documentation, papers, and production guidance.
Studio: plan a multi-GPU training run for a transformer model. Deliverable: identify parallelism strategy, checkpoint policy, bottleneck hypotheses, and scaling metrics.

concepts.name: Distributed training
concepts.description: Training a model across multiple machines, devices, or accelerators.

concepts.name: Data parallelism
concepts.description: Distributed training where workers process different data batches while maintaining copies of the model.

concepts.name: Model parallelism
concepts.description: Distributed training where different parts of a model are placed on different devices or machines.

concepts.name: Parameter server
concepts.description: A distributed training architecture where centralized servers store and update model parameters.

concepts.name: All-reduce
concepts.description: A collective communication operation that aggregates values across workers and shares the result with all of them.

concepts.name: Gradient synchronization
concepts.description: The process of sharing and combining gradients across workers during distributed training.

concepts.name: Checkpointing
concepts.description: Saving model state during training so work can resume or a previous state can be restored.

concepts.name: GPU cluster
concepts.description: A group of machines or devices with GPUs used together for accelerated computation.
